run_deeplab_training: run the DeepLab training script with a config file to train a semantic segmentation model
run_deeplab_evaluation: run the DeepLab evaluation script to evaluate a trained semantic segmentation model on a dataset
build_sem_seg_train_aug: build semantic segmentation training augmentations including resize, random crop, and random flip transforms
build_trainer_evaluator: build a semantic segmentation or Cityscapes evaluator for a given dataset using the Trainer class
setup_deeplab_config: setup DeepLab configuration by merging config files and command line options then freezing the config
